opportunity.eventDescription: Charged when a SAM.gov opportunity row is pushed. A row is pushed only when this charge fits under maxSpendUsd. skipped, blocked, robots, not_found, spend_capped, and error rows are saved and not billed. $0.008 is $8 per 1,000 rows, the top of the listing's affordability line. The brief's $0.01 price is $10 per 1,000 and was not used.

award.eventDescription: Charged when a USAspending contract-award row is pushed. Same $0.008 success-only price as an opportunity. Status rows are not billed.
